item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings — 2026-11-20
item.description: Hyungji I&C filed with Seoul Southern District Court to suspend KRX's delisting decision and its designation as an administrative issue. · Asendio signed a cosmetics supply contract worth KRW 906.4mn (906,443,639원) with an overseas global beauty distributor. · Kkamyu E&C won a KRW 29.48bn contract for the Gangbuk–Amsa water transmission connection works from Public Procurement Service. · IPARK Hyundai Development signed a KRW 350.1bn construction contract with affiliate Ipark I&Cons for a Jinju apartment complex on 2026-11-20. · HDC subsidiary IPARK Hyundai Development signed a KRW 350.1bn construction contract for Jinju Dodong District Block B with affiliate IPARK I&Construction.
